visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing glasses and a white oversized hoodie, speaks directly to the camera in a selfie style. She is indoors with a simple white wall and some clothing hanging on a rack behind her. Her facial expression is wide-eyed and highly expressive as she delivers an introductory hook. (2) She transitions to a balcony by opening a sliding door, and the camera reveals a snowy landscape. Large snowflakes are clearly visible falling against the backdrop of a dense Japanese residential area with grey and tiled roofs. She looks at the camera then out, appearing surprised by the weather. (3) A wide shot captures the neighborhood rooftops covered in a dusting of white snow under a heavy, overcast grey sky. Utility lines and various urban structures are visible in the background. The atmosphere is cold and wintry, contrasting sharply with the typical expectation of the spring season. (4) The woman is back on camera, speaking while her face shows a mix of confusion and amusement. She touches her face and looks towards the side. The lighting is natural but muted due to the overcast weather outside the balcony door. (5) Two still photographs are inserted: one shows her in a mirror selfie wearing a light white shirt and baseball cap, and another shows a vibrant pink cherry blossom tree standing near a stone lantern and a white torii gate in a sunlit park environment. (6) Returning to the live video, she gestures with her hand towards the falling snow outside the window. Her expression is one of disbelief as she explains the sudden weather shift. The video ends with her looking contemplative about the local climate.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to report on a surprising weather event in Tokyo where it is snowing in March despite warm temperatures and cherry blossom sightings just days prior. It uses a personal, high-arousal vlog style to share this 'exaggerated' contrast with the audience.
